entry.note: arXiv math/0409565 = LP2004 'Unital Gröbner Bases over Arbitrary Commutative Ground Rings' (10 pp.). Content: §2 unital GB definitions, Buchberger over R, PBW corollary. NO inner products, NO intertwiners, NO representation theory beyond GB-representations. Verified-clean for folio/unital-groebner-bases/.../groebner-basis.lean (cites Definition 5 of LP2004 — exact match). MISMATCH for folio/quantum-observable-universe/quantum-observable-universes/pawlowski-leitner-inner-product.lean and folio/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/RepresentationTheory.lean — both cite leitnerpawloski2004 for 'PL inner product' / 'PL basis dimension formula', neither of which appears in LP2004. Likely a different Pawlowski-Leitner work (Pawlowski's thesis or a separate representation-theory paper). Author decision pending: (a) add a new bib entry for the actual cited work, (b) change the QOU citation key, or (c) update the QOU content to match LP2004's actual scope. | ADDITIONAL 6 bare-URL Refs upgraded with arxiv preprint info. Confirms the prior partial verification (commit 4abfedfda): the cited 'On the morphisms of non-commutative formal groups' is the SAME math/0409565 — so QOU is consistently citing this work for the Gröbner-bases foundation, with the 2 mismatched 'PL inner product' / 'PL basis' lean files being the only outliers. | UPDATE 2026-05-19 18:18: local copy is library/arxiv-math-0409565v2/0409565v2.pdf (arxiv-id-named — was originally claimed under a hypothetical alias). | UPDATE 2026-05-22: local_pdf path corrected to point at the file that actually exists in uploads/. | RESOLVED 2026-06-24 (author): one Pawloski-Leitner paper confirmed (this arXiv id). The 2 inner-product/basis .lean files were rewired to cite leitnerpawloski2004 as the PL foundation/namesake (the constructions are QOU's own), and the fabricated 'pawlowski-leitner-rep' split entry was deprecated. relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED against the document's own front matter and against the arXiv identifier the registered entry carries. 10 pages; numbered content is Thm 2, Defs 3/4/5, Prop 7, Thm 8 (Buchberger over a commutative ground ring), Cor 9 (PBW). LOAD-BEARING at every unital-groebner-bases site: unital.lean:34, groebner-basis.lean:37, s-polynomial.lean:30, leading-term-data.lean:33, division-algorithm.lean:21, monomial-basis.lean:23, remainder-module.lean:24, admissible-system.lean:31 cite Definitions 3/4/5 and the §2 algorithm, and the document carries exactly those numbered items; glossary-no-quasi-zeros.ts:8 is anchored on the 'without quasi-zeros' hypothesis of Thm 2; direct-limit-lusztig.md:3's flatness-from-normal-form claim is Cor 9. NOT LOAD-BEARING / MISCITED CLAIM at four sites: folio/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/RepresentationTheory.lean:182, :214, :238 and :245 label the key 'PL inner product / intertwiner basis'. Full-text search of the PDF for 'inner product', 'intertwin', 'hermitian' and 'sesquilinear' returns ZERO hits — the document contains no inner product and no intertwiner basis. The corpus already knows this and contradicts itself: folio/quantum-observable-universe/quantum-observable-universes/pawlowski-leitner-inner-product.lean:52 and :57 state that this key 'supplies only the PBW basis, not the inner product'. The key itself is right (the registered entry records an author-directed rewiring); only the attributed content at those four lines is wrong.

keyResults.statement: For a Lie algebra over a commutative ground ring R, the unital Groebner-basis argument yields a PBW basis free as an R-module.
keyResults.useForFolio: The ground-ring generality behind the divided-power/PBW flatness claim at direct-limit-lusztig.md:3.

keyResults.statement: If A is an R-algebra free as an R-module and without quasi-zeros, with an admissible system, and I has a unital Groebner basis, then A/I is free as an R-module.
keyResults.useForFolio: The 'no quasi-zeros' hypothesis the Ch-8 glossary block names.
